brief_title: A Study To Assess GW677954 Used In Combination With Insulin In Subjects Who Have Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Parallel, Placebo-Controlled, Study to Evaluate the Safety and Tolerability of Oral GW677954 Capsules (15 mg) in Combination With Insulin in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
why_stopped: Company decision not related to safety.

primary_outcomes.measure: changes in fluid related parameters as measured by hematocrit and hemoglobin levels and body weight

brief_summary: Many drugs used for the treatment of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus cause the body to retain water. This study will assess whether or not GW677954 causes the body to retain fluid.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* Have been diagnosed by a doctor with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus at least 3 months before Screening
* Have a body mass index within range 25 to 40.0kg/m2 inclusive
* Females who meet above criteria must be physiologically incapable of becoming pregnant (ie., surgically sterilized, or post-menopausal per protocol definition)

Exclusion criteria:

* Significant weight loss or gain in the 3 months before screening
* Have used insulin to treat hyperglycemia within 3 months before screening
* Have a history of fluid retention
* Have uncontrolled high blood pressure
* Have liver disease
* Take loop diuretics (water pills), certain blood thinners, and/or St. Johns Wort. - Have or have had certain kinds of cancer
